value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no Costco open in Oakville yet. The first one is planned at 3471 Wyecroft Rd, near Burloak Dr, with a target opening in fall 2027. For one you can go to now, a deals site puts the Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga as serving Oakville, though that isn't an official Costco source. Burlington has one too, but I don't have its address, and I can't tell which is closest to you.
